packageRules.description: Bump the npm @playwright/test pins and the matching playwright Docker image tags in a single PR

The mcr.microsoft.com/playwright image tags are tracked via the @playwright/test npm identity above so all three .gitlab-ci.yml occurrences and the npm pins move in one PR; disable the built-in Docker manager for this image to avoid a second, independent update

eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y has no released version supporting ESLint 10 yet; cap eslint below v10 until https://github.com/jsx-eslint/eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y/issues/1075 (tracked by PR https://github.com/jsx-eslint/eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y/pull/1081) ships a compatible release

@remcohaszing/eslint v13 requires migrating ~120 call sites across the repo to eslint-plugin-unicorn's stricter rules (e.g. no-array-sort, no-immediate-mutation), and v14 additionally requires ESLint 10, which is capped below v10 until https://github.com/jsx-eslint/eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y/issues/1075 (tracked by PR https://github.com/jsx-eslint/eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y/pull/1081) ships a compatible release; cap below v13 until the lint migration is done and that issue closes
